intro: Ideas I let out to play.
_how: Each piece: src (image, GIF or .mp4 in /public/playground/) and alt (a short description for screen readers). Pieces show in this order. Leave src out for a placeholder. Add "frame": true to give a piece with a white background a thin grey edge.
